component.name: linux-backup
component.summary: Back up and restore a Linux user's environment

description.p: linux-backup captures a Linux user's environment — program configs, SSH keys, KDE Plasma layout, shell setup, user directories, installed-package manifests, and hand-picked custom paths — into one portable, optionally encrypted archive, and restores it back. This GUI is a windowed alternative to the tool's terminal wizard, built on the same selection engine.
Initial packaged build: walking-skeleton GUI, Flatpak canonical + AppImage fallback.
